limitations: Pilot evidence inventory, not a determination of the complete rules applicable on the requested date.
All physical pages of the recovered PDFs are extracted, including attached SOPs. The original circular chain remains incomplete, and attachments retain their historical context.
OCR is machine extracted. Relationship passages and cover dates were visually checked; other OCR, especially tables, requires checking against the PDF.
Effective dates are recorded only where expressly established. Issue dates are not substituted for missing commencement dates.
Version 3.0 says earlier SOP without naming version 2.0; that target remains unverified.
December 2025 circular has no checked original page in this pilot. Later instructions, implementation releases, statutory changes and court decisions have not been exhaustively searched.
Joint Declaration here means WSU member profile correction; higher-pension joint options and paragraph 26(6) declarations are outside scope.
The as-of filter is an issue-date evidence cutoff. Later-issued retrospective directions are excluded; this is not a bitemporal legal applicability resolver.
